crossover.rule: A donor to one of the six primary candidates is counted as a likely match when the normalized name (last name and first name, uppercased, with punctuation, spaces and suffixes such as Jr. removed) and the first five digits of the ZIP code on a Koh or Jones receipt equal those on the earlier receipt, and the Koh or Jones gift is dated after the donor’s first gift to that primary candidate. Only positive, non-memo contributions from individuals on the individual-contribution line count on either side. Two people who share a name and a ZIP code would be counted as one; a donor who moved or used a different name form would be missed.
